entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:1
segments: ¶"If there arises among you a prophet or a dreamer of dreams, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:2
segments: "and the sign or the wonder comes to pass, of which he spoke to you, saying, 'Let us go after other gods' -which you have not known-'and let us serve them,'

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:3
segments: "you shall not listen to the words of that prophet or that dreamer of dreams, for the LORD your God is testing you to know whether you love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:4
segments: "You shall walk after the LORD your God and fear Him, and keep His commandments and obey His voice, and you shall serve Him and hold fast to Him.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:5
segments: "But that prophet or that dreamer of dreams shall be put to death, because he has spoken in order to turn [you] away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of bondage, to entice you from the way in which the LORD your God commanded you to walk. So you shall put away the evil from your midst.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:6
segments: ¶"If your brother, the son of your mother, your son or your daughter, the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, secretly entices you, saying, 'Let us go and serve other gods,' which you have not known, neither you nor your fathers,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:7
segments: "of the gods of the people which [are] all around you, near to you or far off from you, from [one] end of the earth to the [other] end of the earth,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:8
segments: "you shall not consent to him or listen to him, nor shall your eye pity him, nor shall you spare him or conceal him;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:9
segments: "but you shall surely kill him; your hand shall be first against him to put him to death, and afterward the hand of all the people.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:10
segments: "And you shall stone him with stones until he dies, because he sought to entice you away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:11
segments: "So all Israel shall hear and fear, and not again do such wickedness as this among you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:12
segments: ¶"If you hear someone in one of your cities, which the LORD your God gives you to dwell in, saying,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:13
segments: 'Corrupt men have gone out from among you and enticed the inhabitants of their city, saying, "Let us go and serve other gods"' -which you have not known-

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:14
segments: "then you shall inquire, search out, and ask diligently. And [if it is] indeed true [and] certain [that] such an abomination was committed among you,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:15
segments: "you shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword-utterly destroying it, all that is in it and its livestock, with the edge of the sword.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:16
segments: "And you shall gather all its plunder into the middle of the street, and completely burn with fire the city and all its plunder, for the LORD your God. It shall be a heap forever; it shall not be built again.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:17
segments: "So none of the accursed things shall remain in your hand, that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of His anger and show you mercy, have compassion on you and multiply you, just as He swore to your fathers,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 13:18
segments: "because you have listened to the voice of the LORD your God, to keep all His commandments which I command you today, to do [what is] right in the eyes of the LORD your God.
